task.description: Decide whether a Toronto special event is ready. Record exactly one outcome: resolve_insurance, resolve_emergency_plan, resolve_food, resolve_alcohol, resolve_sound, resolve_structures, or ready.

outcome_descriptions.resolve_sound: Not ready: amplified sound exceeds ordinary limits without an approved exemption.
outcome_descriptions.resolve_structures: Not ready: a temporary structure lacks the necessary permit or documentation.

decision_policy.summary: Record the unresolved check, or ready if all six checks pass. At most one check is unresolved in any scenario, so no priority order is needed.
design_rationale: The variables correspond to separate sections of Toronto’s event-planning guidance.
The task is scoped to an event for which an EAP and $2 million venue insurance are required.
Not applicable states distinguish absent regulated activities from satisfied requirements.

Scenarios contain at most one unresolved check (generation_plan.invalid_configurations excludes every pair of unresolved states), so each non-ready outcome names that check and the rules are mutually exclusive; rule order is presentational.
Real permit reviews often find several open items at once; restricting to one is a benchmark scoping choice that removes any dependence on a priority order.
Ready is limited to these six checks and is not the issued permit.

rules.explanation: The scoped City location requires a compliant insurance certificate.
The selected event scope requires a complete EAP.
Public food service triggers food-safety responsibilities.
Alcohol service requires the applicable permissions and controls.
Sound must meet ordinary limits or an approved exemption.
Applicable temporary-structure permits and approvals must be documented.
All six scoped event-readiness checks pass.

prose_document.title: Toronto Special-Event Readiness Checklist
prose_document.content: Review insurance, emergency planning, food, alcohol, amplified sound and temporary structures. Record the check that is unresolved, or ready if all six pass. This is a scoped internal checklist, not a City permit decision.
